title: The Last Bajaj
logline: On a rushed evening in Nazreth, a last bajaj, a sudden rain and a game of cards lead to the night my brother Ermias shared his good news.
audience: Ermias himself first, then our family and close friends, on their phones, in our family WhatsApp group.
intent: They should feel like they were there with us that night, and celebrate Ermias's news.
